title: Interactive Anatomy Skeleton Viewer
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D anatomy skeleton viewer using Three.js. The entire application must be in a single HTML file.

## Three.js Import
Use this importmap in <head>:
<script type="importmap">
{ "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/examples/jsm/"
} }
</script>
Then in <script type="module">:
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { OrbitControls } from 'three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js';

## Scene Setup
- Background gradient from 0x1a1a2e (bottom) to 0x16213e (top) — use a simple solid 0x1a1a2e.
- PerspectiveCamera at (0, 8, 15), looking at (0, 6, 0).
- OrbitControls enabled.
- Ambient light (0x606080), hemisphere light (sky 0xaaaaff, ground 0x444422, intensity 0.6), directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at (5, 15, 10).

## Skeleton Structure
- Build a hierarchical skeleton from simple geometric primitives (cylinders for bones, spheres for joints).
- 22 bones total, organized hierarchically:
  - Spine: pelvis → lumbar → thorax → neck → skull (5 bones)
  - Left arm: l_clavicle → l_upper_arm → l_forearm → l_hand (4 bones)
  - Right arm: r_clavicle → r_upper_arm → r_forearm → r_hand (4 bones)
  - Left leg: l_thigh → l_shin → l_foot (3 bones)
  - Right leg: r_thigh → r_shin → r_foot (3 bones)
  - Ribcage: 3 rib pairs (simplified as curved cylinders or torus segments)
- Default bone color: 0xf5e6ca (ivory). Joint spheres: 0xddccaa.
- Approximate human proportions: total height ~12 units, pelvis at y=5, skull top at y=12.

## Interactions
- Raycaster-based clicking: click on any bone to select it.
- Selected bone highlights in 0xff6644 (orange-red) and a label (id='label-bone') shows the bone name.
- Press 'T' to toggle bone transparency (opacity 0.3) on all non-selected bones.
- Press 'E' to toggle explode view: spread bones apart along their local axes by 1.5x distance from center.
- Press 'R' to reset (no selection, no transparency, no explode).
- Press '1' for front view, '2' for side view, '3' for top view (animate camera).

## HUD (id='hud')
- Selected bone name (id='hud-bone'): name or 'None'
- Total bones (id='hud-total'): always 22
- Transparency mode (id='hud-transparent'): 'ON' or 'OFF'
- Explode mode (id='hud-explode'): 'ON' or 'OFF'
- Camera view (id='hud-view'): 'Front' / 'Side' / 'Top' / 'Free'

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ updated every frame:
- `selectedBone`: string or null
- `totalBones`: number (always 22)
- `isTransparent`: boolean
- `isExploded`: boolean
- `cameraView`: string ('front'|'side'|'top'|'free')
- `frameCount`: number
- `bonesValid`: boolean (no NaN positions)
- `cameraDistance`: number (rounded to 1 decimal)

Ensure the animation loop updates __3D_STATE__ every frame before rendering.
physics_constraints: All 22 bones must be present in the scene. Bone hierarchy must be maintained (child bones move with parent). Selected bone must change color. Explode view must increase inter-bone distances. Transparency must affect material opacity. No NaN in any bone position.
